notes.title: Upcoming Updates & Improvements
notes.content:
[h2]Upcoming Updates for [i]Knight of Justice[/i][/h2][p]The next update for [i]Knight of Justice[/i] is coming soon in early October![/p][list][*][p]We’re adding [b]Simplified and Traditional Chinese language support[/b]. （感谢玩家的回馈，我们将在下次更新增加简体中文和繁体中文的支持！）[/p][/*][*][p]Visual improvements and environment design updates are also on the way.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Graphics Settings Bug (Temporary Notice)[/b]: Currently, the [b]Low[/b] graphics setting is applying [b]High[/b] quality, and [b]High[/b] is applying [b]Low[/b] quality. This bug has already been fixed and the correction will be included in the next major update.[/p][/*][/list][p]In addition, the [b]Original Soundtrack[/b] will be released next month! 🎵[/p][p]Stay connected:[/p][list][*][p]Follow us on [b]X (Twitter)[/b] for the latest news and updates.[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [b]Discord[/b] to share feedback, discuss the game, and take part in our future giveaway events. (Link available on our Steam store page or at the bottom of this post.)[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you all for your amazing support — it means the world to us! 💙
— [i]StarFlow Studio[/i][/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 – Tutorial & UI Fixes
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.1

Fixed an issue with the Defeat UI displaying incorrectly.
Fixed a tutorial mission bug: players will now correctly receive the mission to buy units from the blacksmith NPC before the first defense mission.

notes.title: Upcoming Tutorial Bug Fix
notes.content:
[p]Bug description:
A tutorial mission is currently being skipped by accident. This does [b]not[/b] stop overall game progression, but it may cause some confusion.[/p][p]🔹 [b]Details:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Players need to purchase defensive units at the [b]Blacksmith NPC[/b] before they can be deployed in battle.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Defeated” UI is also not displaying properly.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve already fixed this issue, but due to a Steam security lock the patch won’t be available until early next week.[/p][p]✅ Players can still progress through the game normally — just remember to purchase defensive units before starting [b]Reina’s mission[/b]![/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience and support.
[/p][p]— StarFlow Studio[/p]
